'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Western Russia attacks]]
***[[Russian nationalism|Russian nationalist]] writer [[Zakhar Prilepin]] is injured and his driver is killed when their vehicle is hit by a [[car bomb]] in [[Nizhny Novgorod Oblast]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65509809 (BBC News)]
*[[2023 Manipur violence]]
**At least 30 people are killed in ethnic clashes in [[Manipur]], [[India]], after a rally by [[Meitei people|indigenous communities]] against moves to grant tribal status to the main ethnic group in the state. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-65513157 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Two [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] men, members of the Tul Karm Battalion, are killed during a raid by the [[Israeli Defense Forces]] in [[Tulkarm]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-05-06/ty-article/.premium/two-palestinians-killed-by-idf-in-west-bank-palestinian-health-ministry-says/00000187-ef96-d8a1-a1cf-efbf59ee0000 (''Haaretz'')]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Two [[People's Anti-Fascist Front]] militants are killed and another is injured during two raids by [[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] in [[Rajouri]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], after five soldiers were killed yesterday. [https://apnews.com/article/kashmir-india-pakistan-rebels-soldiers-6b853e02135c3a48da92c4bb4ff03b97 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Yanaquihua gold mine fire]]
**At least 27 people are killed after a fire breaks out in a gold mine in [[Yanaquihua District]], [[Condesuyos Province]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-miners-killed-after-suspected-fire-gold-mine-2023-05-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Alberta wildfires]]
**Over 25,000 residents in [[Alberta]], [[Canada]], are ordered to evacuate because of wildfires. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/05/05/weather/alberta-canada-wildfires-evacuations/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Arab separatism in Khuzestan]]
**[[Habib Chaab|Farajollah Chaab]], a leader of the [[Arab Struggle Movement for the Liberation of Ahwaz]], is [[Capital punishment|executed]] by [[hanging]] in [[Iran]] after being [[criminal conviction|convicted]] of masterminding a 2018 [[mass shooting]] [[Ahvaz military parade attack|on a military parade]] in [[Ahvaz]] that killed 25 people. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-execution-deadly-attack-parade-acd9dd6ceecf28ad48e6d52e722185a4 (AP)]
*[[2023 Allen, Texas outlet mall shooting]]
**Eight people are killed and seven injured during a [[mass shooting]] at a shopping mall in [[Allen, Texas]], [[United States]]. The perpetrator is killed by police. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/06/us/allen-texas-mall-shooter-reports/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Coronation of Charles III and Camilla]]
**King [[Charles III]] and [[Queen Camilla]] are crowned in a ceremony at [[Westminster Abbey]] in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2023/may/06/king-charles-iii-crowned-at-westminster-abbey-coronation (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2023 Asia heat wave]]
**[[Vietnam]] records its [[List of weather records|highest ever temperature]] of 44.2 °C (111.56 °F) in the [[Tương Dương district]], [[Nghệ An province]], while [[Laos]] records its highest ever temperature of 43.5 °C (110.3 °F) in [[Luang Prabang]] amid a [[heat wave]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/may/08/weather-tracker-vietnam-and-laos-set-records-for-highest-ever-temperatures (''The Guardian'')]

**[[Mage (horse)|Mage]] wins the [[Kentucky Derby]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/horse-racing-mage-wins-kentucy-derby-2023-05-06/ (Reuters)]
